Game Overview

Go Chicken Go is a fun game built around guide a flock of frantic chickens on a perilous journey to freedom. Dodge speeding traffic, navigate treacherous rivers, and aim for lush green safety. With intense challenges and heart-pounding suspense, every decision determines their fate. Will your chickens cluck to safety or face a feathery end?
